description: A signed receipt stored in a player's repository confirming they unlocked a game achievement.

main.description: Published in the player's own PDS when an achievement is earned. Display metadata lives on the game's `achievement.definition` record; legitimacy is proven via inline CID-first cryptographic `signatures` from the game publisher's `#attestations` DID key (and subject to `games.opengaming.revocation` records in the game's PDS).

achievement.description: AT-URI of the `games.opengaming.achievement.definition` record in the game publisher's repository.

definitionCid.description: Optional CID snapshot of the `achievement.definition` record at the moment of unlock. Kept optional and decoupled from `achievement` so cosmetic/typo edits to the definition never orphan player unlocks.

game.description: Optional AT-URI of the game definition (`games.atmosphere.define`), included so indexers can group unlocks by game without an extra lookup.

player.description: DID of the player who earned this achievement (must match the repository DID housing this record).

unlockedAt.description: Timestamp when the achievement was earned.

stepsCompleted.description: Optional final step count reached when unlocking an incremental achievement.

signatures.description: Inline CID-first cryptographic attestations (`games.opengaming.defs#inlineSignature`) signed by the game publisher's `#attestations` DID key over the repository-bound DAG-CBOR CID of this record. Unsigned records MUST be treated as unverified/self-reported, and records matching a publisher `games.opengaming.revocation` MUST be treated as revoked.
